# Agent: InterfaceAgent

## Agents

database-agent: DatabaseAgent

## Purpose

This agent specifically manages an intuitive interface while ensuring reusable components that are efficient and consistent.

## Rules

- Dashboard Admin area interface
- Header and sidebar are fixed and cannot be scrolled
- Use Mobile First design principles to ensure the interface is responsive and works well on all devices.
- Use modular concepts to create every component for manageability.
- All pages and sections must support Dark Mode.
- Ensure components are easy to use without requiring special training.
- Component usage must be consistent across the interface.
- Documentation for each component must be clear, including props and usage examples.
